arxiv-2106-01361.title: Mixed-parity octupolar pairing and corner Majorana modes in three dimensions
arxiv-2106-01361.creator: Bitan Roy, Vladimir Juričić
arxiv-2106-01361.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Bitan Roy, Vladimir Juričić. We identify time-reversal symmetry breaking mixed-parity superconducting states that feature eight Majorana corner modes in properly cleaved three-dimensional cubic crystals. Namely, when an odd-parity isotropic p p -wave pairing coexists with cubic symmetry preserving even-parity octupolar d x 2 − y 2 + i ​ d 3 ​ z 2 − r 2 d_{x^{2}-y^{2}}+id_{3z^{2}-r^{2}} pairing, the gapless surface Majorana modes of the former get localized at the eight corners, thus yielding an intrinsic third-order topological superconductor (TOTSC).

arxiv-2106-09075.title: Electronic Structure of the Bond Disproportionated Bismuthate Ag 2 BiO 3
arxiv-2106-09075.creator: Mohamed Oudah 1,2, Minu Kim 1, Ksenia S. Rabinovich 1, Kateryna Foyevtsova 2, Graham McNally 1, Berkay Kilic 1, Kathrin Küster 1, Robert Green 2,3, Alexander V. Boris 1, George Sawatzky 2, Andreas P. Schnyder 1, D. A. Bonn 2, Bernhard Keimer 1, Hidenori Takagi 1,4
arxiv-2106-09075.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mohamed Oudah 1,2, Minu Kim 1, Ksenia S. Rabinovich 1, Kateryna Foyevtsova 2, Graham McNally 1, Berkay Kilic 1, Kathrin Küster 1, Robert Green 2,3, Alexander V. Boris 1, George Sawatzky 2, Andreas P. Schnyder 1, D. A. Bonn 2, Bernhard Keimer 1, Hidenori Takagi 1,4. We present a comprehensive study on the silver bismuthate Ag 2 BiO 3 , synthesized under high-pressure high-temperature conditions, which has been the subject of recent theoretical work on topologically complex electronic states.

arxiv-2112-04916.title: Coherent Asymmetric Absorbers
arxiv-2112-04916.creator: F.S. Cuesta 1, A.D. Kuznetsov 1,2, G.A. Ptitcyn 1, X. Wang 1, S.A. Tretyakov 1
arxiv-2112-04916.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by F.S. Cuesta 1, A.D. Kuznetsov 1,2, G.A. Ptitcyn 1, X. Wang 1, S.A. Tretyakov 1. Most applications of metasurfaces require excitation and control of both electric and magnetic surface currents. For such purpose, the metasurface must have a finite thickness to handle magnetic surface currents. For metasurface sheets of negligible thickness that offer only electric response, coherent illumination can compensate the need to create discontinuities of the tangential electric field component using magnetic surface currents.

arxiv-2112-10562.title: Hardness of the Generalized Coloring Numbers
arxiv-2112-10562.creator: Michael Breen-McKay, Brian Lavallee, Blair D. Sullivan
arxiv-2112-10562.description: Abstract The generalized coloring numbers of Kierstead and Yang (Order 2003) offer an algorithmically-useful characterization of graph classes with bounded expansion. In this work, we consider the hardness and approximability of these parameters. First, we complete the work of Grohe et al. (WG 2015) by showing that computing the weak 2-coloring number is NP-hard.

arxiv-2204-07560.title: AI-driven Development Is Here: Should You Worry? Journal: Software
arxiv-2204-07560.creator: Neil A. Ernst, Gabriele Bavota
arxiv-2204-07560.description: Abstract \jvol XX \jnum XX \paper 8 \jmonth May/June \sptitle Department: SE4AI \editor Editor: Tim Menzies, timm@ieee.org From the Editor: The benefits, as well as the draw-backs, of new AI technology needs to be carefully scrutinized. For example, in this article, researchers review the promise, and potential pitfalls, of AI tools that help programmer co-write their code.

arxiv-2306-01543.title: Existence of two distinct valence bond solid states in the dimerized frustrated ferromagnetic J 1 J_{1} - J 1 ′ J_{1}^{\prime} - J 2 J_{2} chain
arxiv-2306-01543.creator: Jędrzej Wardyn, Satoshi Nishimoto, Cliò Efthimia Agrapidis
arxiv-2306-01543.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jędrzej Wardyn, Satoshi Nishimoto, Cliò Efthimia Agrapidis. We study the frustrated and dimerized ferromagnetic-antiferromagnetic J 1 J_{1} - J 1 ′ J_{1}^{\prime} - J 2 J_{2} chain using the density-matrix renormalization group method. Based on numerical calculations of the second derivative of energy, spin gap, spin-spin correlations, string order parameter (SOP), and entanglement spectrum (ES), we obtain the ground-state phase diagram for a wide range of J 1 ′ / J 1 J_{1}^{\prime}/J_{1} and J 2 / | J 1 | J_{2}/|J_{1}| values.

arxiv-2307-14188.title: Understanding the dynamics of randomly positioned dipolar spin ensembles
arxiv-2307-14188.creator: Timo Gräßer, Kristine Rezai, Alexander O. Sushkov, Götz S. Uhrig
arxiv-2307-14188.description: Abstract Dipolar spin ensembles with random spin positions attract much attention currently because they help to understand decoherence as it occurs in solid state quantum bits in contact with spin baths. Also, these ensembles are systems which may show many-body localization, at least in the sense of very slow spin dynamics.

arxiv-2312-15237.title: Towards Fine-Grained Explainability for Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network
arxiv-2312-15237.creator: Tong Li, Jiale Deng, Yanyan Shen, Luyu Qiu, Yongxiang Huang, Caleb Chen Cao
arxiv-2312-15237.description: Abstract Heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNs) are prominent approaches to node classification tasks on heterogeneous graphs. Despite the superior performance, insights about the predictions made from HGNs are obscure to humans. Existing explainability techniques are mainly proposed for GNNs on homogeneous graphs.

arxiv-2406-04217.title: Optomechanical Backaction in the Bistable Regime
arxiv-2406-04217.creator: L. F. Deeg, D. Zoepfl, N. Diaz-Naufal, M. L. Juan, A. Metelmann, G. Kirchmair
arxiv-2406-04217.description: Abstract With a variety of realizations, optomechanics utilizes its light-matter interaction to test fundamental physics. By coupling the phonons of a mechanical resonator to the photons in a high-quality cavity, control of increasingly macroscopic objects has become feasible. In such systems, state manipulation of the mechanical mode is achieved by driving the cavity.

arxiv-2407-15171.title: Assessing Sample Quality via the Latent Space of Generative Models
arxiv-2407-15171.creator: Jingyi Xu, Hieu Le, Dimitris Samaras
arxiv-2407-15171.description: Abstract Advances in generative models increase the need for sample quality assessment. To do so, previous methods rely on a pre-trained feature extractor to embed the generated samples and real samples into a common space for comparison. However, different feature extractors might lead to inconsistent assessment outcomes.

arxiv-2407-18657.title: SWARM-SLR - Streamlined Workflow Automation for Machine-actionable Systematic Literature Reviews
arxiv-2407-18657.creator: Tim Wittenborg, Oliver Karras, Sören Auer
arxiv-2407-18657.description: Abstract Authoring survey or review articles still requires significant tedious manual effort, despite many advancements in research knowledge management having the potential to improve efficiency, reproducibility, and reuse. However, these advancements bring forth an increasing number of approaches, tools, and systems, which often cover only specific stages and lack a comprehensive workflow utilizing their task-specific strengths.

arxiv-2412-20865.title: Trimeron ordering, bandgap and polaron hopping in magnetite
arxiv-2412-20865.creator: Nikita Fominykh, Vladimir Stegailov
arxiv-2412-20865.description: Abstract In this work, we apply the DFT+U approach for a detailed ab initio study of the refined structure of the low-temperature phase of magnetite [M. S. Senn et al., Nature 481 , 173 (2012)]. We compare the electronic properties of this structure and several alternatives with respect to the presence of trimeron ordering and the bandgap properties.

arxiv-2503-01540.title: Stochastic conformal integrators for linearly damped stochastic Poisson systems
arxiv-2503-01540.creator: Charles-Edouard Bréhier, David Cohen, Yoshio Komori
arxiv-2503-01540.description: Abstract . We propose and study conformal integrators for linearly damped stochastic Poisson systems. We analyse the qualitative and quantitative properties of these numerical integrators: preservation of dynamics of certain Casimir and Hamiltonian functions, almost sure bounds of the numerical solutions, and strong and weak rates of convergence under appropriate conditions.

arxiv-2503-15686.title: Multi-focal Conditioned Latent Diffusion for Person Image Synthesis
arxiv-2503-15686.creator: Jiaqi Liu, Jichao Zhang, Paolo Rota, Nicu Sebe, University of Trento, Ocean University of China
arxiv-2503-15686.description: Abstract The Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) has demonstrated strong capabilities in high-resolution image generation and has been widely employed for Pose-Guided Person Image Synthesis (PGPIS), yielding promising results. However, the compression process of LDM often results in the deterioration of details, particularly in sensitive areas such as facial features and clothing textures.

arxiv-2510-12207.title: Perturbative χ \chi EFT calculations of the deuteron and triton up to N 2 LO
arxiv-2510-12207.creator: Oliver Thim, Andreas Ekström, Christian Forssén
arxiv-2510-12207.description: Abstract We extend previous studies of the deuteron and triton ground-state energies to next-to-next-to-leading order (N 2 LO) in chiral effective field theory, employing a power counting in which subleading interactions are treated perturbatively. Triton calculations are performed using the no-core shell model, and we demonstrate converged perturbative results for regulator cutoffs up to Λ ≈ 1200 \Lambda\approx 1200 MeV.

arxiv-2601-10877.title: Is open robotics innovation a threat to international peace and security?
arxiv-2601-10877.creator: Ludovic Righetti, Vincent Boulanin
arxiv-2601-10877.description: Abstract Open access to publication, software and hardware is central to robotics: it lowers barriers to entry, supports reproducible science and accelerates reliable system development. However, openness also exacerbates the inherent dual-use risks associated with research and innovation in robotics. It lowers barriers for states and non-state actors to develop and deploy robotics systems for military use and harmful purposes.

arxiv-2602-16195.title: Phase Transitions in Collective Damage of Civil Structures under Natural Hazards Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2602-16195.creator: Sebin Oh, Jinyan Zhao, Raul Rincon, Jamie E. Padgett, Ziqi Wang, Sebin Oh, Jinyan Zhao, Raul Rincon, Jamie Padgett, Ziqi Wang, Sebin Oh, Jinyan Zhao, Raul Rincon, Jamie E. Padgett, Ziqi Wang, Sebin Oh, Jinyan Zhao, Raul Rincon, Jamie Padgett, Ziqi Wang
arxiv-2602-16195.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Sebin Oh, Jinyan Zhao, Raul Rincon, Jamie E. Padgett, Ziqi Wang, Sebin Oh, Jinyan Zhao, Raul Rincon, Jamie Padgett, Ziqi Wang, Sebin Oh, Jinyan Zhao, Raul Rincon, Jamie E. Padgett, Ziqi Wang, Sebin Oh, Jinyan Zhao, Raul Rincon, Jamie Padgett, Ziqi Wang. The fate of cities under natural hazards depends not only on hazard intensity but also on the coupling of structural damage, a collective process that remains poorly understood. Here we show that urban structural damage exhibits phase-transition phenomena.

pmc-10572330.title: The Effect of Hole Geometry on the Nonlinear Nanomechanics of γ-Graphyne Structures: A Finite Element Analysis
pmc-10572330.creator: Stelios K Georgantzinos, Sotirios G Siampanis, Nikolaos Rogkas, Vasilios Spitas, Miroslav Mrlík
pmc-10572330.description: Graphyne is a material that has unique mechanical properties, but little is known about how these properties change when the material has holes. In this work, the effect of hole geometry, considering circular, triangle, and rhombus hole configurations, on the mechanical nonlinear response of γ-graphyne structures is studied. Graphyne, graphdiyne, graphyne-3, and graphyne-4 structures are under investigation.

pmc-10737524.title: ARE COMPLETING ONLINE ASSIGNMENTS CORRELATED TO KIRKPATRICK’S LEVEL 2 AND 3 LEARNING OUTCOMES?
pmc-10737524.creator: Huai Cheng
pmc-10737524.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundPre-class assignments such as online assignments are critical to a flipped classroom-based curriculum. However, it is unknown whether medical students are following online assignments and whether such compliance is associated with learning outcomes. The aim of this study was 1) to examine the compliance of the online assignments and 2) explore whether such compliance was associated with Kirkpatrick’s Level 2 and 3 learning outcomes.

pmc-10744618.title: Carbon Nanotubes and Graphene Materials as Xenobiotics in Living Systems: Is There a Consensus on Their Safety?
pmc-10744618.creator: David Gendron, Grzegorz Bubak
pmc-10744618.description: Carbon nanotubes and graphene are two types of nanomaterials that have unique properties and potential applications in various fields, including biomedicine, energy storage, and gas sensing. However, there is still a debate about the safety of these materials, and there is yet to be a complete consensus on their potential risks to human health and the environment.

pmc-11337860.title: Targeting mitochondrial quality control: new therapeutic strategies for major diseases
pmc-11337860.creator: Wei-Long Hong, He Huang, Xue Zeng, Chen-Yang Duan
pmc-11337860.description: Mitochondria play a crucial role in maintaining the normal physiological state of cells. Hence, ensuring mitochondrial quality control is imperative for the prevention and treatment of numerous diseases. Previous reviews on this topic have however been inconsistencies and lack of systematic organization.

pmc-11456925.title: Different Degeneration Patterns of Paraspinal Muscles Between Double-Level and Single-Level Lumbar Spondylolisthesis: An Magnetic Resonance Imaging Analysis of 140 Patients
pmc-11456925.creator: Yi Li, Ruiling Wang, Junjun Li, Linfeng Wang, Yong Shen
pmc-11456925.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the degeneration patterns of paraspinal muscles in double-level degenerative lumbar spondylolisthesis (dl-DLS) versus single-level degenerative lumbar spondylolisthesis (sl-DLS). MethodsA total of 67 dl-DLS and 73 sl-DLS patients were included. Multifidus (MF), erector spinae (ES), and psoas major (PM)’s fatty infiltration (FI) and relative cross-sectional area (rCSA) were measured.

pmc-11472004.title: Low CD46 expression on activated CD4+ T cells predict improved Th1 cell reactivity to calcitriol in majority of patients with allergic eosinophilic asthma and healthy donors
pmc-11472004.creator: Julie Stichova, Peter Slanina, Zita Chovancova, Jan Baros, Marek Litzman, Jiri Litzman, Marcela Vlkova
pmc-11472004.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundPrevious research showed that the intracellular complement system, with CD46 as its central molecule, regulates the Th1 response associated with IFN-γ production and transition to a type 1 regulatory response (Tr1) characterized by IL-10 production.

pmc-11499564.title: Analytical microscopy techniques using coaxial and oblique illuminations to detect thin glass particulates generated from glass vials for parenteral drug products
pmc-11499564.creator: Adedayo M. Sanni, Adedamola A. Opalade, Armen Shamirian, Spencer Mattson, Eric Driscoll, Michael St. Martin, Shikhar Mohan, Brooke Trimmer, Tarq Bunch, Robert Ovadia, Jungjoo Yoon, Sarina Ma, Chris Foti
pmc-11499564.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Glass vials are the most widely used primary containers for the packaging of parenteral products due to their optical clarity, general inertness, and hermetic properties, but under certain circumstances, they can pose safety concerns. Most of these issues are related to the potential formation of glass particulates through delamination or precipitation, resulting from the chemical interaction between the drug product and the inner surface of the glass vial.

pmc-12385633.title: Comparative Evaluation of Customized CAD/CAM vs. Stock Titanium Abutments for Immediate Implant Placement in Class II Extraction Sockets: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-12385633.creator: Ali Robaian, Mohamed Mofreh Hamed, Yousra Ahmed, Fatma E. A. Hassanein
pmc-12385633.description: Background: Immediate implant placement in the esthetic zone, particularly in Class II extraction sockets with partial facial bone loss, presents challenges in achieving soft and hard tissue stability. Customized computer-aided design/computer-aided manufacturing (CAD/CAM) titanium abutments may offer advantages over prefabricated stock abutments.

pmc-13138902.title: Assessment of anatomical outcomes in the upper urinary tract following flexible ureteroscopy with flexible and navigable suction ureteral access sheath: 1‐year results from a multicentre study
pmc-13138902.creator: Steffi Kar Kei Yuen, Chi‐Fai Ng, Khi Yung Fong, Bhaskar Kumar Somani, Boyke Soebhali, Mohamed Elshazly, Vigen Malkhasyan, Karl Tan, Luis Rico, Mehmet Ilker Gokce, Han Jie Lee, Nariman Gadzhiev, Tzevat Tefik, Jianwei Cao, Albert El Hajj, Chi‐Ho Leung, Jeremy Yuen Chun Teoh, Oliver Traxer, Ben Hall Ch
pmc-13138902.description: IntroductionFlexible and navigable suction access sheath (FANS) with flexible ureterorenoscopy (FURS) has demonstrated favourable 30‐day and 3‐month outcomes for renal stones in normal anatomy. We aimed to investigate the long‐term 1‐year safety and efficacy of FANS for renal and ureteric stones in normal or anomalous anatomy.

pmc-13585043.creator: William H. Eger, Maia H. Hauschild, Erika L. Crable, Logan A. Hehner, Katie Bailey, M. Gudelia Rangel, Alicia Harvey-Vera, Carlos Vera, Annick Bórquez, Heather A. Pines, Eileen V. Pitpitan, Thomas L. Patterson, Steffanie A. Strathdee, Angela R. Bazzi
